d: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.
The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) act like strangers to catch a crooked lawyer.
The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.
President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).
A youth from Gabby Whittaker's (George "Gabby" Hayes) Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes becomes a pawn in the fight between his late father's gang and Roy Rogers.
A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) helps a slain rancher's daughter (Ruth Terry) breed horses for the Army.
Modern-day cattle rustlers use a radio, airplanes and refrigerator trucks to expedite their illegal schemes.
A singing-cowboy congressman (Roy Rogers) goes to Washington to save ranchers from a power dam.
Not long after ambitious prospector J. Malcolm Vanderpool takes an interest in the run-down remnants of a small frontier town, fortune seekers from all over rush to gain a silver mine of their own.
Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.
The frontiersman (Bruce Bennett) leads settlers to Kentucky, where he makes peace with a Shawnee chief (Lon Chaney).
A baseball star (Lou Gehrig) goes west with his sister (Evalyn Knapp) and helps a lawyer (Smith Ballew) bust a cattle-protection racket.
A sergeant (Lin McCarthy), a colonel (Stephen Courtleigh), a thief (Berry Kroeger) and two other Rebel deserters trek toward Cuba through the Everglades.
Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.
Townsfolk turn against their sheriff (Harry Carey) because of his outlaw son (Edward Norris).
An ex-convict bandit (Marlon Brando) finds the partner (Karl Malden) who betrayed him is now a town sheriff with a wife (Katy Jurado) and daughter.
An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.
A cowboy sleuth (Harry Carey) catches rustlers despite a rattlesnake.
A Mountie tracks mine robbers in the 1890s Canada.
In their first cinematic outing, Red Ryder and his Indian sidekick help a newspaper publisher clean up her town.
A boy raised by his servant vows to take revenge on the ranchers who killed his parents.
A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

Former partner Milt Brower (William Farnum) and Pa Jackson (Stanley Andrews) are engaged in an embittered land dispute that turns ugly when Jackson accuses Brower of the dastardly crime of cattle rustling.
A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) clears the outlaw (Donald Barry) and his gang of a bank robbery done by bankers.

Rex (Rex Allen) and Slim (Slim Pickens) journey to Colorado, where Slim is expecting to claim the estate of the departed Zeke Reynolds, but the will also includes Jacqueline Reynolds and the evil Hurley siblings, and a fight ensues.
A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.

After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

Former Texas Ranger Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), now an attorney, is called back into law enforcement by his old pals Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson), who want his help recovering some stolen gold.
A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.
A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.
Posing as an Asian, a Washington agent goes after a gem-smuggling outlaw gang.
Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.
The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.
After the war with Mexico, cavalry officers try to steal land from Mexican peasants to establish their own empire.
Heirs of a radium mine owner face murder attempts. A mining engineer investigates to find the killer and prove his cousin's innocence. The mine's value motivates the crimes.
When a young man discovers gold, he must deal with threats.
Outlaw lumbermen frame a singing cowboy (Gene Autry) ; his friend (Jimmy Lloyd) saves him with a plane.
A cowboy (Bob Steele) framed for murder breaks out of jail to prove his innocence.
A cowboy (Ken Maynard) rousts rustlers and woos a blonde (Lucille Powers) on the range.
The frontier hero (Roy Rogers) sings and saves Civil War gold with his sidekick (George "Gabby" Hayes).
A marshal (Jim Davis) uses an outlaw's (Don Megowan) girlfriend (Allison Hayes) as bait to lure him into a showdown.

t: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
d: Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and vows to retake the land that once belonged to his forefathers.
Pat seeks the killer of a U.S. Postal Inspector.
The towns people of Bender, Montana take a band of gypsies to court.
Pat and Stoney are ordered to break up a safe cracking gang preying on Colorado banks handling government silver bullion.
US mint has been buying silver diluted with lead; Pat and Scotty set out to find the criminals.
Bobbie Jo falls for Alan Landman (Dennis Hopper), a poet and beatnik.
Billie Jo discovers that her late father wanted her to be a doctor.
Kate asks the judge if she can legally keep Billie Jo from going to Hollywood.
A movie star escapes from the Hollywood madness in Shady Rest.
Annie, Lofty and Tagg (Gail Davis, Brad Johnson, Jimmy Hawkins) step in when a store owner is killed and his young daughter is left blind. With Judy Nugent.
Annie becomes suspicious of Elaine Forbes, the seemingly innocent niece of a recently deceased rancher.
Outlaw Vic Carver (Robert B. Williams) seeks revenge against Sheriff MacTavish (Kenneth MacDonald) for sending him to jail.
Annie (Gail Davis) races to save her retired mentor (Stanley Andrews) from a suicide mission with a merciless young gunman. With Ric Vallin.
Annie and Tagg (Gail Davis, Jimmy Hawkins) track a masked bandit who holds up an acrobatic troupe. With Brad Johnson.
Annie (Gail Davis) plays matchmaker for her friend Bess Murdock (Nancy Hale). With Don Kennedy, Brad Johnson.
Annie relies on Tagg's ability as a ventriloquist to save an innocent stage driver from angry townspeople.
Tagg (Jimmy Hawkins) and his friend Billy (Stuffy Singer) run away to a ghost town inhabited by an outlaw gang. With Gail Davis.

On the run from the law over false charges, Jesse James and his friend find refuge in a small town threatened by a gang trying to claim the oil deposits beneath it. While there, he meets a pretty woman and father who are in danger.
Government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) is accused of shooting up a saloon and has to escape from the jail to find the man behind the murders.
A cowboy (Jack Perrin) and his sidekick (Frank Rice) pursue a gang of smugglers and save a Mexican dancer (Tina Menard).
Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and sidekick Lucky (Russell Hayden) help a railroad man (Matt Moore) thwart a land baron.
A French girl (Lily Damita) joins a wagon train from Missouri led by two scouts and their young partner (Gary Cooper).
The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, Dennis Moore, Max Terhune) track outlaws to their hide-out.
A tungsten miner (Bill Boyd) loves his father's rival's daughter (Helen Twelvetrees) and fights off her other suitor (Clark Gable).
Billy the Kid (Buster Crabbe) stages a shootout with outlaws who have transformed an innocent young lady into a wanted desperado.
When white settlers start to move in on their sacred grounds, a tribe of female Indians vow to do anything they can to stop them.

A New York police officer, shot and wounded by a gangster, travels to Cheyenne, Wyo., to recuperate at his family's ranch, and is surprised to find a bootlegger from New York running a speakeasy there.
U.S. marshals (Johnny Mack Brown, Raymond Hatton) catch rustlers swapping cattle for Mexican jewels.
An Easterner (George O'Brien) finds rustlers and a sweetheart (Irene Hervey) on the ranch he inherited out West.
Matt must restore order to a town controlled by outlaws.
Pat and Stoney investigate a land title dispute.
The agents travel to Central City to investigate the disappearance of two Postal Inspectors.
Uncle Joe convinces two overweight women that the Shady Rest is really a reducing farm, where their loss is management's gain.
Railroad executive Homer Bedloe arrives in Hooterville with a railroad tycoon, who is determined to purchase the Cannonball.
A man travels to Hooterville to investigate a line connection.
Kate wants to hide the Hooterville Cannonball to save it from the scrap heap.
A couple of con men attempt to lure Letty into their scheme and get her to go to San Francisco.
A Texas Ranger is shot down in cold blood and Judge and Jeff are determined to break the case.
Judge Roy along with Taggart are intrigued by the arrival of Pat O'Hara and much younger wife Kate; Pat's fondness for drink and gambling has him involved with the town's rowdies.
Deputy Jeff Taggart is framed in the murder of a horse trader.
Judge Bean appoints himself as the legal guardian of a young man whose father was a member of an outlaw gang; the boy's uncle puts a bounty on his head.
Judge Bean's decisions displease some people, like prohibitionist Dolly Mason; she backs opposing candidate Duke Castle, an outlaw who claims he's reformed.
A young boy runs away from home because his father doesn't stand up to his abusive boss.
A woman arrives in town looking for her son; Roy finds out that her son is not only in the area, but has become a notorious outlaw.
The search for a missing medicine arrow sparks a series of Indian attacks. Feature version of the serial.
A Mountie (Bob Steele) escorts a young woman bringing cash to her father in the wild.
Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.
Hopalong Cassidy rides shotgun for a freight company and comes up against a gang of outlaws posing as cavalrymen.
The Three Mesquiteers set out to trap outlaws who have robbed a bank and stashed the loot in an abandoned village.
A law officer tries to bring a traitorous mine foreman to justice.
A French Foreign Legion captain (George Raft) loves an enemy Arab chieftain's daughter (Marie Windsor).
A blacksmith's son (Johnny Mack Brown) goes to New Mexico to find his benefactor's (William Farnum) disinherited granddaughter (Beth Marion).
The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) join a spooky search for a lost city of riches.
